# La Winspire

> La Winspire is the Kokapet, Hyderabad practice of Dr. P. Madhurima Reddy, psychologist and author with 28 years in practice. Couple, family and individual therapy, in person (Kokapet) and online.

Contact: +91 91007 31594 · info@lawinspire.com · #77 Magadha Village, Kokapet, Hyderabad, Telangana 500075
Not an emergency service. If you are in crisis, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, 24×7).
